verdict.line: You lose if you keep trading past Mordekaiser's third Darkness Rise proc or get poked down by Obliterate before level 6; you win if you survive to full tank items where his damage stops scaling with yours.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) deals increased damage when it hits a single target, which is why he holds both the lane and solo-kill edge in the data. Ornn's trades need setup first — Brittle off W (Bellows Breath) or a knockup off terrain with E (Searing Charge) — so even trades aren't available to him on demand the way they are to Morde. That gap closes once Ornn's tank itemization and global R come online, which is why the head-to-head still sits at 49.9% over 1601 games despite Morde's early advantage.

theirWindow.what: Darkness Rise (passive) procs, giving him a damage aura and move speed. Back out of the trade now — every exchange past this point favors him.

yourWindow.what: Indestructible is down for up to 12 seconds with no shield or heal available. Commit your full Q (Volcanic Rupture) into E (Searing Charge) combo now.

powerCurve.note: Your Brittle combo starts evening trades

start.why: Its passive mitigates chip from champion attacks and abilities and heals you on being hit by a champion — a direct answer to Morde's Q poke and auto-reset pattern before level 6.

boots.why: Mordekaiser is pure magic damage, so the magic resist and tenacity blunt his Q poke and cut the duration of his E (Death's Grasp) pull if you get caught.

core.why: Percentage health damage mitigation and AoE pressure answer Morde's sustained auto/aura damage better than flat stats do.
Health and omnivamp let you win the extended trades he's built to win via his passive aura and W sustain.
Stacking resistances directly counter a champion whose entire kit is sustained magic damage over time rather than one big burst.

situational.when: he's leaning on auto-attacks and the passive aura to win extended trades
you need early grievous wounds to cut his W (Indestructible) heal
his damage is spiking hard around his R all-in and you need a burst shield

runes.keystoneWhy: Every proc heals you on an auto exchange, which directly offsets Obliterate poke and sustained auto damage during the laning phase where he's ahead.

summoners.why: Ignite's burn cuts into the healing he gets off W (Indestructible) and this pairing measures at 54.5% in the matchup. Flash+Teleport is the higher-pick, more macro-flexible option if you'd rather play for side-lane scaling than lane kills.

playing.title: Trade right after his Q lands
playing.detail: Punish Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate, 8-4s cooldown) the instant he throws it — it hits hardest on a single target and he has nothing else to follow up with until it resets. Step in with your own Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow.

playing.title: Track Darkness Rise stacks
playing.detail: Mordekaiser's passive grants a damage aura and move speed after 3 landed attacks or spells on you. Disengage before the third proc — any trade past it belongs to him.

playing.title: Punish his W cooldown
playing.detail: Indestructible (12-8s cooldown) is his only shield/heal tool. Once he spends it, commit your full combo — Q slow into E if you can clip terrain — for up to 12 seconds with no answer from him.

playing.title: Summon your ult from range, not in response
playing.detail: If his R (Realm of Death) drags you into his dimension, your own R elemental disappears while you're trapped. Summon it from max range (2500) before he's inside his 650-range ult threat, not after.

playing.title: Use E near terrain, not open ground
playing.detail: E (Searing Charge) only knocks up if you collide with terrain while charging. Fight near walls so this becomes your all-in tool against a champion with no hard disengage of his own.

playing.title: Respect his E pull near brush
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in its area toward him from 700 range. Don't facecheck blind into that radius — a mistimed walk puts you in free Q and auto range.

playing.title: Build into sustained damage, not burst
playing.detail: His threat comes from the passive aura and W sustain over time, not a single burst combo. Prioritize Hollow Radiance and Jak'Sho's percentage mitigation over burst-answer items.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, pick rates, and win-rate numbers above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the ability readings, trade windows, and tactical calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Mordekaiser’s (P) gives him the upper hand in prolonged fights. Time your [W] well to block (E) and (R). Be careful that your [R] will disappear inside Mordekaiser’s Realm of Death (R), so try to use it from afar.
